Package neqsim.pvtsimulation.util

Class DepletionPvtHistoryGenerator

java.lang.Object
neqsim.pvtsimulation.util.DepletionPvtHistoryGenerator
public final class DepletionPvtHistoryGenerator extends Object
Evaluates modified black-oil PVT from the actual CVD or DLE depletion path and one fixed separator process.

The Whitson-Torp phase-flash interpretation is an approximation to full component conservation. This API checks native component conservation separately, evaluates its surface oil/gas closure error, and refuses a handoff above the caller's justified acceptance tolerance. It never substitutes independent original-composition flashes for a depletion experiment. The supported grid has two hydrocarbon phases at every interpreted point. Water-containing depletion samples, absent-phase extrapolation, critical closure, injection paths and separator changes are rejected or outside this bounded model. Bw comes from a separately accepted pure-water EOS, not an invented default.

Version:
1.0
Author:
Even Solbraa

  • Method Details

    • generate

      public static DepletionPvtHistoryGenerator.Result generate(CalibratedPvtModel model, MaterialBalancePvtHistory.Path path, String pathReference, double temperatureK, double[] pressuresBara, double[] separatorPressuresBara, double[] separatorTemperaturesK, SystemInterface waterFluid, String waterReference, double maximumRelativeSurfaceError, String toleranceReference)
      Replays an accepted dry hydrocarbon sample through CVD or DLE and evaluates one unchanged separator process.

      All supplied pressures must strictly decrease and exceed the first separator pressure. Every grid point must contain both oil and gas, including the first interpreted point. The first retained cell defines the zero origin of the reported experiment withdrawals; any earlier sample-to-grid withdrawal remains visible in snapshot zero. Equilibrium phase volumes use the EOS volume correction and surface gas is the dry gas phase after the complete process, including any stock-tank condensate from each separator's offgas.

      Parameters:
      model - immutable original/tuned laboratory-calibration bundle
      path - CVD or DLE; other path types are unsupported
      pathReference - software/protocol evaluation reference
      temperatureK - fixed reservoir temperature in K
      pressuresBara - complete decreasing experiment grid, at least three two-phase points
      separatorPressuresBara - fixed decreasing separator pressures ending at 1.01325 bara
      separatorTemperaturesK - stage temperatures ending at 288.15 K
      waterFluid - separately accepted pure-water EOS, containing water only
      waterReference - provenance and acceptance of the water EOS at these conditions
      maximumRelativeSurfaceError - positive acceptance bound below one for both surface pseudo-components
      toleranceReference - engineering justification of the approximation bound
      Returns:
      accepted PVT, native snapshots, experiment withdrawals and approximation diagnostics
      Throws:
      IllegalStateException - if phase availability, conservation, flashes or approximation acceptance fails
